offering_description.value: Supplies scalable on-site power systems for data centers, ports, oil and gas operations, and other sites that need reliable electricity. Customers can obtain power through energy agreements or equipment rentals and contract for long-term maintenance.

quotes.quote: From 65 kW to multi-MW systems, our scalable, ultra-reliable on-site, on-demand solutions power data centers, microgrids, ports, EV charging, oil & gas operations, and even festivals and events.

In addition to our core energy platform, Capstone’s expanding portfolio includes flexible Energy as a Service offerings: build own transfer models, power purchase or energy service agreements (PPAs/ESAs), lease to own structures, and rental services that eliminate or minimize upfront capital requirements and accelerate time to power. These models are designed for speed, flexibility, and energy security. And to help provide life cycle cost predictability, we offer extensive Long Term Service Agreements with options for planned only or planned and unplanned maintenance.

primary_products.value: Fuel-flexible microturbine generators; modular multi-megawatt power systems; combined cooling, heating and power systems

quotes.quote: Today, Capstone Energy+ delivers scalable, fuel flexible generator solutions built on our three core engine platforms: 65kW, and 200kW. By configuring our 200kW engine into multi bay, integrated modules that can also be isolated for simplified maintenance, we deliver multi megawatt systems designed for rapid deployment and continuous operation.

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Onboard marine microturbines are subject to exhaust emissions limits

The onboard clean-and-green microturbines, meet strict emission regulations without additional exhaust aftertreatment. "Argonon Shipping strives to be an innovative, socially-responsible company and Capstone microturbines absolutely fit our mission to have a clean-and-green profile."
